digest.component_or_area: LLM model configuration seam (gates, providers, per-pass selection)
propositions: A single REBAR_LLM_MODEL environment variable cannot express the required per-pass model mapping: Pass-1 finder must use opus-family (frontier class) while Pass-2/Pass-4 (verify/coach) must use sonnet-family (standard class).

Code-review gate's five LLM-calling steps (base, round_a, round_b, verify, coach) implicitly inherit cfg.model because only verify declares model:standard; base, round_a, round_b, and coach must declare their class explicitly.

On non-default providers (Bedrock), the model_ladder and per-step model declarations are not honoured at runtime due to a plumbing defect, causing all steps to resolve to the default cfg.model instead of their declared class.

The verifier downgrade to sonnet-family is skipped when operator configures a non-default provider, because the equality rule conflates provider change with explicit model override, leaving Pass-2/Pass-4 on expensive opus models.

Per-pass model selection requires both a configuration mechanism (model_classes and per-class REBAR_LLM_* overrides, already shipped by epic eb58) and plumbing fixes to actually pass step-level declarations through to the resolver at runtime.
